paite: TOUPA ka vak leh hon hondampa ahi; kua ka lau dia? TOUPA ka hinna insang ahi; kua ka kihta dia?
heading: David La / Phatna Thumna
english: By David. Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

paite: Thil hoih lou hihte, hon doute leh ka melmate'n, ka sa nek tum a hon sual lai un, akisui ua, apuk chiat uhi.
english: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

paite: Sepaih pawlte'n hon sual tum in hon giahkhum mah le uh ka lungtang in akihta kei ding; ka tung ah kidouna hong suak mahleh, huchipi in leng ka gingta tinten ding hi.
english: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah thil khat ka ngen a, huai mah ka zong ding; TOUPA kilawmdan mu ding leh, atempul a thu dong ding in ka damsung teng a TOUPA' inn a ka om gige theihna ding in.
english: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

paite: Mangbat ni inn a bukta ah hon koihkhian ding ahi ngal a, ahumbitna puanin ah hon sel ding a; suangpi tung ah hon khakai ding hi.
english: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

paite: Tu in hon doute, hon umsuakte tunglam ah ka lu dopkang in a-om ding; huchi in apuanin ah nopna kithoihnate ka lan ding a; la ka sa ding.
english: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka aw a ka hon sapleh ngaikhia inla; ka tung ah zahngai inla, dawn leng hon dawng in.
english: Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

paite: Ka mel zong un, chi a na gen lai in, ka lungtang in na kiang ah, TOUPA mel ka zong ding, ka chi hi.
english: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”

paite: Ka lak ah na mai sel ke'nla; na sikha heh in hihmang ke'n, nang zaw hon panpihpa na hi gige a; hon hondampa Pathian aw, hon paikhe ke'nla hon paisan ke'n.
english: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

paite: Ka nu leh ka pa'n hon paisanta uhi, himahleh TOUPA'N ahon pom lai ding.
english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.

paite: TOUPA aw, na lampi hon ensak inla; ka melmate ziak in lampi phei mahmah ah hon pi in.
english: Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

paite: Hon doute ut-ut a hih ding in hon pe mahmah ke'n; theihpih dikloute'n hon sual ua, nunsiat thu sekhe nakte'n.
english: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

paite: Mihing gam ah TOUPA hoihna muh kigingta lou hi leng ka bahta ding hi.
english: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.

paite: TOUPA ngak gige in; hattak in om in, na lungtang kihihhang in; ahi, TOUPA ngak gige in.
english: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
